goal: EXAMPLE ONLY: Build a small local counter page with increment and reset actions, and cloud export.
constraints: EXAMPLE ONLY: Use local HTML, CSS, and browser JavaScript only; do not add unapproved external dependencies.
Worker self-checks (build, lint, local tests) permitted as needed; unrun checks recorded honestly as NOT_RUN.
Do not commit, push, merge, deploy, or edit outside the allowed worktree scope.

acceptance.requirement: The page starts at 0; clicking Increment increases the value by 1.
acceptanceCriteria: Initial page load renders counter with value 0
Clicking the Increment button increases displayed value by 1

acceptance.requirement: Clicking Reset when the value is nonzero returns it to 0.
acceptanceCriteria: Reset button is rendered on the counter page
Clicking the Reset button restores counter value to 0

acceptance.requirement: Export counter history to cloud endpoint.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking Export History initiates upload to configured cloud endpoint
